verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Sumsub publishes an API reference section describing its RESTful APIs, but nothing shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples such as a try-it console. The Sandbox is a separate test environment, not an interactive reference, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404, so there is no direct support for the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
